ops.en: deep regret and guilt for something wrong one has done
ops.cn: 悔恨；因自己的过错或不当行为而产生的深切后悔和内疚

ops.en: feeling or showing deep regret or guilt about one's actions or wrongdoing
ops.cn: 悔恨的；对自己的行为或过错深感后悔、内疚的

ops.en: a version or interpretation of a work, account, scene, or subject
ops.cn: 版本；诠释；对作品、叙述、场景或主题的呈现方式

ops.en: a performance of a piece of music, drama, or other artistic work
ops.cn: 演奏；演出；对音乐、戏剧等作品的表演

ops.note: Specialized legal-political use, especially extraordinary rendition: transferring a detainee to another jurisdiction or country, often controversially.

ops.en: formal: to give up, reject, or formally declare that one no longer claims a right, belief, position, or connection
ops.cn: （正式）放弃；宣布不再主张某项权利、信念、地位或关系

ops.en: to formally give up power, duties, obligations, or authority
ops.cn: 正式放弃权力、职责、义务或权威

ops.note: Can also mean formally giving up a post or position.

ops.en: to restore a depleted supply, amount, or stock to a former or desired level
ops.cn: 补充；把已减少的供应、数量或储备恢复到原有或所需水平

ops.en: to reproduce, duplicate, or make a close or exact copy of something
ops.cn: 复制；复现；制作相同或高度相似的副本

ops.en: to repeat an experiment, study, or procedure in order to obtain or verify the same result
ops.cn: 复现实验或研究；重复实验以获得或验证相同结果

ops.en: biology: to reproduce or make a copy of genetic material, a cell, virus, or other biological entity
ops.cn: （生物学）复制、增殖；如 DNA、细胞或病毒的复制

ops.en: to refuse to accept, recognize, or be bound by something as valid or legitimate
ops.cn: 拒绝接受、承认或受某事约束；否认其有效性或正当性

ops.en: to reject, deny, or disown a claim, belief, accusation, or association
ops.cn: 否认；拒绝；与某主张、信念、指控或关系断绝

ops.en: to refuse to acknowledge or pay a debt or obligation
ops.cn: 拒绝承认或偿付债务、履行义务

ops.en: extremely unpleasant, disgusting, or causing strong aversion
ops.cn: 令人厌恶的；令人反感的；极其讨厌的

ops.note: Technical/literal sense: producing or involving a repelling force.

ops.en: the general opinion or reputation that people have of someone or something, whether good or bad
ops.cn: 名声；声誉；人们对某人或某事物的总体评价，可好可坏

ops.en: an official demand or request for supplies, services, property, or other resources, especially by an authority
ops.cn: 征用要求；正式申请；尤指当局对物资、服务、财产等提出的正式要求

ops.en: to formally demand, request, or take supplies, services, or property for official use
ops.cn: 正式征用、要求或申请物资、服务或财产供官方使用

ops.note: Also a form or document used to make an official request.

ops.en: formal: for a quality, power, responsibility, right, or authority to exist or be vested in someone or something
ops.cn: （正式）存在于；归属于；权力、责任、权利或权威等由某人/某事物拥有

ops.meaning_cn: （权力、责任、权威等）存在于、归属于某人或某事物

ops.en: producing, reinforcing, or characterized by a deep, rich, ringing, or echoing sound
ops.cn: 共鸣的；洪亮回响的；声音深沉而富有回声的

ops.en: figurative: strongly evocative, meaningful, relevant, or emotionally powerful for someone
ops.cn: （比喻）引起强烈共鸣的；意义深远的；与某人高度相关的

ops.meaning_cn: 对某人有强烈共鸣；与某事呼应、意义相关

ops.en: the process of breathing and exchanging gases with the environment
ops.cn: 呼吸；吸入氧气并排出二氧化碳等气体交换过程

ops.en: cellular respiration: biochemical processes by which cells release energy from nutrients
ops.cn: 细胞呼吸：细胞通过生化过程从营养物质中释放能量

ops.en: the act or process of returning something or someone to a former, satisfactory, or rightful condition or position
ops.cn: 恢复；修复；复原；使恢复到原有、良好或应有状态/地位

ops.note: An object or work that has been restored or reconstructed.

ops.value: Lowercase restoration is the ordinary lexeme. Capitalized Restoration for the historical English period is case-bounded historical reference truth, not lowercase learner Core.

ops.en: reserve or unwillingness to speak, reveal thoughts, or sometimes act openly about something
ops.cn: 沉默寡言；有所保留；不愿谈论、透露想法或公开行动

ops.meaning_cn: 对某事有所保留、不愿多谈
对做某事有所顾虑或不愿公开行动
ops.note: Keep this tied to reserve/self-restraint rather than generic reluctance.

ops.en: to withdraw, take back, or formally disavow a statement, claim, offer, promise, or accusation
ops.cn: 撤回；收回；正式撤销声明、主张、提议、承诺或指控

ops.en: to draw or pull back an extended body part, object, or mechanism
ops.cn: 缩回；收回伸出的身体部位、物体或机构

ops.note: Specialist surgical use: hold tissue or a wound open with a retractor.

ops.en: for sound, impact, light, heat, or waves to echo or be repeatedly reflected
ops.cn: 回响；反射；声响、冲击、光、热或波反复传播或反射

ops.en: figurative: for an event, action, or consequence to continue having effects or spread through a wider system
ops.cn: （比喻）持续产生影响；后果不断扩散、回荡

ops.en: a feeling of deep respect, veneration, or awe
ops.cn: 敬畏；崇敬；深切的尊重

ops.en: an act or gesture showing deep respect, such as a bow or curtsy
ops.cn: 表示崇敬的行为或礼节，如鞠躬、屈膝礼

ops.en: to regard with deep respect, veneration, or awe
ops.cn: 崇敬；敬畏；怀着深切尊重看待

ops.meaning_cn: 恢复到、回到某事物或先前状态/形式/话题

ops.en: to officially cancel, withdraw, or make invalid a right, license, law, offer, decision, or permission
ops.cn: 正式撤销、取消或使权利、执照、法律、提议、决定或许可失效

ops.note: Card-game noun: failure to follow suit when required.
Card-game verb: fail to follow suit when able and required.

ops.en: a serious break, split, or disagreement in a relationship, group, organization, or alliance
ops.cn: 裂痕；严重分歧；关系、团体或联盟中的破裂

ops.note: Literal geological sense: a narrow fissure or split in rock.
A gap or break in cloud masses.

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: strictness, thoroughness, precision, and exacting standards in thought, method, or work
ops.cn: 严谨；严格；周密；在方法、思考或工作中坚持高标准

ops.en: severity, hardship, or a demanding condition that is difficult to endure
ops.cn: 严酷；艰苦；难以承受的严苛条件

ops.en: excessive strictness, severity, or sternness
ops.cn: 过度严格；严厉；苛刻

ops.meaning_cn: 科学/学术上的严谨性和严格标准

ops.en: an established ceremonial act, custom, or formal practice, often but not necessarily religious
ops.cn: 仪式；礼俗；约定俗成的正式典礼或习俗，常见于宗教但不限于宗教

ops.meaning_cn: 人生阶段的过渡仪式；象征进入新阶段的经历

ops.en: basic, elementary, or only partly developed
ops.cn: 基础的；初步的；尚未充分发展的

ops.en: showing or feeling regret, sorrow, or embarrassment, often with a wry or self-aware quality
ops.cn: 懊悔的；遗憾而略带苦笑或自嘲的；因尴尬而悔恨的

ops.en: old-fashioned/literary: a violent, brutal, rough, or lawless man or person
ops.cn: （旧式/文学）恶棍；粗暴凶狠、无法无天的人

ops.en: old-fashioned or literary: a violent, brutal, or lawless person
ops.cn: （旧式/文学）粗暴凶狠、无法无天的人；恶棍

ops.en: to disturb, fluff up, wrinkle, or disarrange something such as feathers, hair, or a surface
ops.cn: 弄乱；使蓬起；使起皱，如羽毛、头发或表面

ops.en: figurative: to upset, irritate, or disturb someone's calm or confidence
ops.cn: （比喻）惹恼；使不安；打乱某人的平静或自信

ops.meaning_cn: 惹恼某人；触怒人；引起不满

ops.en: rough, uneven, rocky, or difficult in surface or terrain
ops.cn: 崎岖的；凹凸不平的；地形粗糙难行的

ops.en: sturdy, durable, strongly built, or able to withstand difficult conditions
ops.cn: 坚固耐用的；强健的；能经受恶劣条件的

ops.en: harsh, demanding, or severely testing endurance
ops.cn: 艰苦的；严峻的；极考验耐力的

ops.en: a deep, low, continuous or rolling sound
ops.cn: 低沉的隆隆声；持续滚动般的低响

ops.en: to make or move with a deep, low, rolling sound
ops.cn: 发出低沉隆隆声；轰隆隆地移动

ops.en: to think deeply, carefully, or repeatedly about something
ops.cn: 反复思考；深思；沉思

ops.en: to search through or among things, often quickly, untidily, or thoroughly
ops.cn: 翻找；乱翻着寻找；在一堆东西中仔细搜寻

ops.meaning_cn: 在某处或一堆东西中翻找、搜寻

ops.note: Noun use referring to a jumble or miscellaneous items is secondary/dated.

ops.en: rural or characteristic of the countryside; simple, plain, or attractively rough in style
ops.cn: 乡村的；质朴的；乡野风格的；自然粗犷而有吸引力的

ops.en: dated and sometimes disparaging: an unsophisticated person from the countryside
ops.cn: （旧式，有时贬义）乡下人；被认为不够世故的人

ops.en: to droop, sink, bend downward, or lose firmness because of weight, pressure, weakness, or age
ops.cn: 下垂；下陷；因重量、压力、松弛或老化而向下弯沉

ops.en: to cause something to droop, sink, or bend downward
ops.cn: 使下垂；使下陷；使向下弯曲

ops.en: a downward curve, droop, or decline
ops.cn: 下垂；下陷；向下弯曲或下降

ops.en: figurative: to weaken, fall, or decline in level, energy, demand, price, or performance
ops.cn: （比喻）减弱；下降；需求、价格、表现等走低

ops.en: wise, shrewd, perceptive, and showing sound judgment
ops.cn: 睿智的；精明而有洞察力的；判断明智的

ops.en: beneficial, useful, or having a corrective effect, sometimes through an unpleasant lesson or experience
ops.cn: 有益的；具有改善或纠正作用的；有时指虽不愉快但有教育意义的

ops.meaning_cn: 有益的效果；有警醒或纠正作用的一课

ops.en: to save or recover something from loss, damage, wreck, destruction, or failure
ops.cn: 抢救；挽救；从损失、损坏、事故或失败中救回某物

ops.en: figurative: to rescue what can still be saved from a bad situation, failed effort, or damaged reputation
ops.cn: （比喻）挽回局面、努力或声誉中仍可挽救的部分
